title: Scalar compatibility of section restriction and evaluation
statement: Let $\Lambda,S$ be commutative condensed rings and $c:\Lambda\to S$ a morphism of ring objects [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms]. Use the specified exact restriction of scalars, universal right-derived comparisons and section arrows [def-sfb-closed-test-scalar-comparison-maps] and the specified models and comparison maps [def-sfb-closed-test-scalar-model-diagrams]. For every scheme morphism $b:X\to Y$, site objects $W$ over $Y$ and $W_1$ over $X$, and site arrow $t:W_1\to b^*W$, the ordinary section arrow commutes with scalar restriction and the pullback/scalar isomorphism. The derived section arrow satisfies the corresponding square with forward gamma. The direct-image evaluation isomorphism at $W$ commutes with forward gamma at $W,b^*W$ and the direct-image scalar comparison. These are precisely the last three clauses of SectionCoherence; its computation-unit clause is not part of this statement.

proof.text: On underlying sections scalar restriction preserves the actual adjunction-unit section and its presheaf restriction. Transport the scalar adjunction and its unit through the section equivalence to prove the ordinary square.

Apply rightDerivedPullback composition to the ordinary square. The two paths have the same equation against the computation unit on every complex. Universal uniqueness gives the derived square with the canonical exact pullback/scalar compositor.
For direct-image evaluation both paths are induced by the literal identity (b_*F)(W)=F(b^*W). Their equations against computation units agree; universal uniqueness identifies them.

theorem closed_test_scalar_section_squares :
(∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (b : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.ProEt) (W' : X.ProEt)
      (t : W' ⟶ testFibre b W)
      (F : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj S Y)),
    (sectionArrow S b W W' t).app F ≫
        (evaluation Λ W').map ((CondensedRing.comapUpperStarIso c b).hom.app F) =
      (sectionArrow Λ b W W' t).app ((restriction c Y).obj F)) ∧
  (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (b : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.ProEt) (W' : X.ProEt)
      (t : W' ⟶ testFibre b W)
      (N : DerivedCategory
        (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj S Y))),
    (derivedSectionArrow S b W W' t).app N ≫
        (gamma c W').app ((CondensedRing.upperStar S b).mapDerivedCategory.obj N) ≫
        (evaluation Λ W').rightDerivedFunctor.map
          ((CondensedRing.derivedComapUpperStarIso c b).hom.app N) =
      (gamma c W).app N ≫
        (derivedSectionArrow Λ b W W' t).app ((restrict c Y).obj N)) ∧
  (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (b : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.ProEt)
      (N : DerivedCategory
        (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj S X))),
    (derivedPushEvaluation S b W).hom.app N ≫ (gamma c (testFibre b W)).app N =
      (gamma c W).app ((CondensedRing.moduleObjectDerivedPushforward S b).obj N) ≫
        (evaluation Λ W).rightDerivedFunctor.map ((restrictPush c b).app N) ≫
        (derivedPushEvaluation Λ b W).hom.app ((restrict c X).obj N))
